title: ui test scheduling: ui tests that read files outside ui/ that no ui filter row covers, beyond docs/adr
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding of the #37935 dev, measured with the shared walker on head `3402071c` (os-dev report, #37935 comment 7232776944); filed on seat 1's routing. Source: seat repo:objectstack#1 area `o1-F`.
Grading: area:fleet · Bug · p2 · reach: ui scheduling on PRs that edit only a file outside `ui/` that a ui test reads · evidence: walker measurement over all ui tests.
Dedupe: `ui tests reading outside ui` → 44 hits, none on this class beyond #37935 itself (which covers `docs/adr` only).

## 维护者速读

- 问题：有几条 ui 测试会读取 ui 目录以外的文件。只改这些文件的 PR 不会触发 ui 测试，所以它们弄坏的东西要等合进主干后才暴露。#37935 只修了其中一类（ADR 文档）。
- 修法：把 #38124 的检查从 ADR 推广到「ui 测试读到的所有 ui 外文件」，再把缺的路径补进 ui 过滤规则，或改成测试不读这些文件。
- 要你做的：无。

## Rule

Every file a ui test reads outside `ui/` either has a ui filter row in `ci.yml`, or is a declared, commented trade-off there. The parity gate from PR #38124 checks this for the whole class, not only for `docs/adr`.

## Measured

The #37935 dev's walker run (comment 7232776944, `out_of_scope_findings`, first item) lists the reads found today and one that is already a declared trade-off. Re-measure on the then-current head before fixing.

## Acceptance

- The parity gate's subject covers every out-of-`ui/` read the walker sees, with a positive control.
- Each found read is covered by a filter row or declared as a trade-off with its reason.

Order: after PR #38124 merges (same gate). Blocked-by: #37935
